figures.caption: Table 3: VLM performance across all 14,617 candidates under GC and OD protocols. GC input: (image, subject description 𝑇 , pre-enumerated candidate list) → D/E/N label per candidate. OD input: (image, 𝑇 ) → free-text labels, grounded to masks by SAM 3. SAM3%: fraction of enumerated labels converted to a non-empty mask. FN loc %: OD false negatives from spatial grounding failure. 𝚫F1 = OD F1 − GC F1. Metrics defined in Section 5.2.
